item.name: Dawnwind Village
item.mainUse: Learn combat and buy your first Katana
item.keyNpcs: Katana seller, Group Reward NPC, Cid
item.notableUnlocks: Katana for 2,500 coins, Stylish Bandit Slayer from Cid, Cid's Key from Bandits for Cid's Castle
item.cardSummary: The starter island every new character lands on. Buy the Katana, claim group rewards, and finish Cid's Stylish Bandit Slayer quest before you teleport on.

item.name: Deeproot Jungle
item.mainUse: Buy Dual Katana and Gryphon, then start Observation Haki
item.keyNpcs: Dual Katana seller, Gryphon seller, Kokushibo, Sogeking
item.notableUnlocks: Dual Katana for 30,000 coins, Gryphon for 75,000 coins and 100 gems, Observation Haki quest, Moon Breathing from Kokushibo
item.cardSummary: The first upgrade island after Dawnwind. Players also call it Jungle Island. Buy Dual Katana or Gryphon here and start Observation Haki with Sogeking.

item.name: Frostborn Island
item.mainUse: Unlock Armament Haki, Yoru, and Shadow
item.keyNpcs: Dark Blade seller, Buso Haki NPC, Shadow NPC, Shadow mastery
item.notableUnlocks: Armament Haki, Yoru, Shadow spec, Shrine Key from Snow Bandit for Plane of Euthymia
item.cardSummary: The snowy mid-game stop for Armament Haki, Yoru, and the Shadow spec. Snow Bandit can drop the Shrine Key used to open Plane of Euthymia.

item.name: Scorched Ruins
item.mainUse: Unlock artifacts and trial portal keys
item.keyNpcs: Sung Jin Woo, Sung mastery, Shadow Daggers NPC, Portal Key seller, Artifact NPC
item.notableUnlocks: Artifact system, trial portal keys, Shadow Daggers, Player's Dagger route
item.cardSummary: The mid-game systems island. Unlock artifacts and trial portal keys here, then continue the Sung Jin Woo and Shadow Daggers routes.

item.name: Jujutsu Highschool
item.keyNpcs: Sorcerer Summoner, Gojo, Sukuna, Gojo mastery, Sukuna mastery, Curse Orb NPC
item.notableUnlocks: Cursed Orb quest from the five Talismans, Gojo and Sukuna styles
item.cardSummary: The Gojo and Sukuna island. Finish the five-Talisman Cursed Orb quest, then use the Sorcerer Summoner to spawn both style bosses.

item.name: Hueco Mundo
item.mainUse: Late Bleach grind plus Aizen and Ichigo
item.notableUnlocks: Zangetsu route, Aizen and Ulquiorra summons, Scatthen Key for Wandenreich
item.cardSummary: The late Bleach grind island. Farm Hollow and Arrancar, then summon Aizen or Ulquiorra and push the Scatthen Key route toward Wandenreich.

item.name: Shinjuku Showdown
item.mainUse: Unlock Gojo Shinjuku and Sukuna Shinjuku
item.keyNpcs: Shinjuku Summoner, Gojo Shinjuku NPC, Sukuna Shinjuku NPC
item.notableUnlocks: Gojo Shinjuku and Sukuna Shinjuku styles, True Six Eye, True Sukuna Finger, Slash Core, Limitless materials
item.cardSummary: The endgame Jujutsu island for Gojo Shinjuku and Sukuna Shinjuku. Official Trello never published a level range for this destination.

item.name: Lineage Town
item.mainUse: Reroll fruits, traits, race, titles, and rank
item.keyNpcs: Trait Reroll, Title NPC, Rank-up NPC, Fruit Reroll, Race Reroll, Merchant
item.notableUnlocks: Fruit rolls, trait, race, title, and rank management, Absolute Ether Key from the Miyabi banner
item.cardSummary: The safe hub with no combat grind. Come back here to roll fruits, reroll traits and race, change titles, and rank up.

item.name: Monument Isle
item.mainUse: Run Tower for shards and permanent upgrades
item.keyNpcs: Tower, Tower Upgrade, Tower Shop, Miyabi mastery
item.notableUnlocks: Tower shards and upgrades, Glamoth Planet Key from Tower and Byte shops
item.cardSummary: The Tower island. Climb for Tower Shards and permanent upgrades, then spend them at the Tower and Byte shops. Official Trello never published a level range.

item.name: Legend's Arena
item.mainUse: Summon and farm mid and late bosses
item.keyNpcs: Boss Summoner, Boss Exchange, Deku, Saber
item.notableUnlocks: Summon-core boss loop, Saber and Excalibur materials, Ryuudo Key for Ryuudo Cave
item.cardSummary: The main boss-summon island. Spend summon cores at the Boss Summoner for Verdant Hero, Saber, and later Gilgamesh or Kokushibo, then trade leftovers at Boss Exchange.

item.name: Fossil Island
item.mainUse: Farm Sung Jin Woo and Rimuru
item.keyNpcs: Sung Jin Woo, Slime Summoner, Rimuru, Rimuru mastery, Book Exchange
item.notableUnlocks: Sung Jin Woo and Rimuru drops, Cartenon Key for Cartenon Temple, Slime materials
item.cardSummary: The Sung Jin Woo and Rimuru farm island. Sung Jin Woo respawns on a timer. Hand a Slime Orb to the Slime Summoner to swap in Rimuru.
